record.paper_title: Developments and open problems on chiral polytopes
record.original_question: Classify all finite and infinite chiral k-polytopes in R^d, in the range k < d for finite polytopes and k ≤ d for infinite polytopes.

evidence.quote: Problem 37 Classify all finite and infinite chiral k-polytopes in Rd (where k < d for finite polytopes, and k ≤ d for infinite ones).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A chiral $k$-polytope in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is a faithfully realized abstract polytope of rank $k$ whose geometric symmetry group acts with exactly two orbits on the flags such that adjacent flags lie in different orbits (so the polytope is vertex-, edge-, ..., $(k-1)$-face-transitive but not reflexible). The faces are realized as (possibly skew) affine subspaces / point sets in Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$, and the polytope may be finite or infinite (discrete).

Provide a complete classification, up to similarity, of all chiral $k$-polytopes realized in $\mathbb{R}^d$ in the following ranges:
(a) all finite chiral $k$-polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for $k < d$;
(b) all infinite (discrete) chiral $k$-polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for $k \le d$.

In each case, describe the full list of isomorphism types, their geometric realizations, their automorphism groups, and the Schläfli-type data of the resulting polytopes.
artifact.status_search_result: The classification problem is only partially resolved. It is known that chiral polyhedra (rank 3) in ordinary 3-space have been completely enumerated by Schulte, that no finite chiral polyhedron exists in $\mathbb{R}^3$, and that chiral polytopes of full rank can occur only in ranks 4 and 5 (with concrete examples constructed, e.g. a finite chiral 4-polytope in $\mathbb{R}^4$ and an infinite chiral 4-polytope in $\mathbb{R}^3$). However, the full Euclidean classification across all ranges $k<d$ (finite) and $k\le d$ (infinite) has not been completed.

status_evidence.title: Chiral polytopes of full rank exist only in ranks 4 and 5
status_evidence.snippet: A chiral polytope of full rank can only have rank 4 or 5.
status_evidence.claim: Restricts possible ranks of chiral full-rank Euclidean polytopes.

status_evidence.title: Chiral Polyhedra in Ordinary Space, I
status_evidence.snippet: Enumeration of discrete chiral polyhedra in E^3 with finite skew faces and vertex-figures.
status_evidence.claim: Rank-3 case in R^3 essentially classified.

status_evidence.title: A Finite Chiral 4-Polytope in R^4
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a finite chiral 4-polytope realized in R^4.
status_evidence.claim: Existence result (not full classification) in higher rank/dimension.

status_evidence.title: A chiral 4-polytope in R^3
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of an infinite chiral 4-polytope in Euclidean 3-space.
status_evidence.claim: Existence in the infinite case k=4, d=3.
